title: lavatera hederifolia
intro: Lavatera hederifolia, commonly known as the Tree Mallow or Rock Rose, is a flowering plant species in the mallow family, Malvaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in relieving symptoms of digestive issues and skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to soothe and calm irritated tissues, making it a potential treatment for wounds and skin irritations. Bioactive constituents of Lavatera hederifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
